title: Moldova's e-governance agency lets residents check whether their data was accessed in the October cyberattack, NewsMaker reports
date_note: NewsMaker, published 27 November, reports the agency's answer; the attack itself was in October.
summary: NewsMaker.md, citing the Agency for Electronic Governance (AGE), reports that residents can log in to their personal account at evo.gov.md with an electronic signature and open the "data access history" section to see whether their data was accessed in the October cyberattack on state digital services. A similar feature is coming to the EVO mobile app, pending Apple and Google approval.
plain: NewsMaker.md reports Moldovan residents can check at evo.gov.md, in the data access history section, whether their data was accessed in the October attack on state services.
exec: NewsMaker.md reports the agency now offers residents a way to see whether their data was accessed in the October attack.
action: As the agency's guidance reported by NewsMaker.md states, log in at evo.gov.md with an electronic signature and open the data access history section.
